source: Azure Retail Prices API (https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices), list prices, region eastus, priceType Consumption

vm.note: Windows license included; actual deployed SKU. List rate, not an invoice.

os_disk.note: 128 GB Premium SSD; billed hourly, prorated

outbound_data_note: conservative placeholder from the earlier estimate, not re-fetched; inbound data (uploading the model store) is not charged

free_account.credit: USD 200 (in the billing currency) for the first 30 days, eligible new customers only
free_account.spending_limit: on by default and equal to the credit; when credit runs out or expires the subscription is disabled unless upgraded
free_account.card: credit or non-prepaid debit card required; temporary authorization hold only
